summary.text: Brian Hibbetts is a Republican Nevada Assembly member from District 13 who has served since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department officer, he co-founded Ex-Con Inc. NV.

paragraphs.text: Hibbetts was born in Las Vegas, Nevada.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he began volunteering with the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department's Explorer program at 15, joined the department full-time in 1994 and retired in 2021.
Ballotpedia also lists him as a co-founder and director of Ex-Con Inc. NV.
Hibbetts assumed office on November 9, 2022, succeeding Tom Roberts.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Health and Human Services, Legislative Operations and Elections, and Ways and Means committees.
In the 2022 survey, he said that if elected he would work to keep communities safe, promote school choice, strengthen the economy and protect individual freedoms.
